metadata.methods_description: Intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) recordings were acquired and organized according to BIDS standards (version 1.8.0). Data organization and formatting was performed using bids-matlab-tools (version 8.0). The dataset is derived from OpenNeuro dataset ds004851 (DOI: 10.18112/openneuro.ds004851.v2.1.0). Electrode placement locations were documented in the anatomical derivatives. Recording parameters including sampling rates, filter settings, and amplifier specifications are provided in the JSON sidecars accompanying each recording file. Detailed methodology, participant information, data collection procedures, file organization, and usage guidelines are documented in the dataset README and BIDS metadata files.
